create_imagenet_dataset: create an ImageNet dataset instance with a given data path and train or val split
build_imagenet_imdb: build the internal image database by scanning class directories and mapping class IDs to contiguous indices
prepare_imagenet_image: prepare an image for network input with random crop, flip, normalization, and PCA jitter for training
get_imagenet_item: get a preprocessed image tensor and its class label by index from the ImageNet dataset
review_imagenet_class: review the ImageNet class to understand its PyTorch Dataset implementation and image preprocessing pipeline
